rounding_policy.name: EXCEL_ROUND_TO_INTEGER_VND
rounding_policy.rule: round each monetary document value to nearest integer VND; exact half is rounded away from zero
rounding_policy.apply_at: normalized monetary row/document boundary before integer-minor-unit storage
rounding_policy.do_not_apply_at: aggregate-only total after summing fractional source rows

reconciliation_rule: source reconciliation for imported monetary rows compares canonical integer VND against per-row rounded source amounts while retaining raw fractional provenance; zero unexplained variance is required after the declared rounding delta is accounted for
